subject: Commercial onboarding / FinOps alignment check — pilot payment and vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@meditron.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: Amy Cho <amy.cho@meditron.com>, ap@meditron.com
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up on yesterday's demo — procurement questions

Vanessa — thanks again for the demo yesterday. We ran a short sync with procurement and FinOps this morning and they asked me to clarify a few items before we move to a pilot decision. Short answers appreciated so I can feed to the AP intake team.

Highlights from the call and procurement asks:
- Pilot expected to run 6 weeks; estimated spend ~ $1,800/mo. Procurement says anything under $2k/mo can go on our corporate card for pilot accounts, but production engagements >$10k/mo need a PO and full vendor onboarding.
- AP needs to know: billing cadence (monthly vs net terms), whether Redwood issues invoices with vendor tax details, and if you support Coupa or another vendor onboarding system.
- Security/compliance: can you provide W9 and SOC 2 attestation?
- Marketplace: is Redwood available on AWS Marketplace (we prefer single-pane procurements there), or do we need a separate vendor entry?

Can you confirm whether the pilot can run on a card and what the escalation path is if we convert to PO and require a vendor ID? Also, if you have a sample vendor packet or quick checklist for our AP team that would speed review.

Appreciate the quick turn — procurement is asking for answers by EOD Wednesday.

Jordan
Jordan Lee
Product Partnerships 
Meditron Therapeutics
Phone: (415) 555-0199

---
Attachments: none
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@meditron.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on yesterday's demo — procurement questions

Jordan — great to hear procurement is aligned on a fast decision window. Quick answers inline below; attaching a vendor onboarding packet and a sample MSA for your legal/AP teams.

- Pilot payment: Yes — you can run the pilot on corporate card. For hosted API (self-serve) card payments are supported immediately. For dedicated/private deployments we typically require a PO + signed MSA for provisioning.

- Billing cadence & terms: Default is monthly invoicing for enterprise customers (NET30 by request). We can invoice monthly or provide card charges for pilot. If you need NET30 for pilot, we can evaluate on a case-by-case basis (rare for small pilots).

- Vendor onboarding systems: We support vendor onboarding via manual packet (attached) and have customers who use Coupa — we can export the required vendor fields to match your Coupa template. We do not currently have a native Coupa connector, but we can deliver the vendor data and invoices in a format your AP team accepts.

- Tax & compliance: We will provide a W9, and our SOC2 Type II report is available (link in related_links). We can share redacted logs/attestations under an NDA if needed.

- Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace (metered SaaS) — however, Dedicated/Private deployments and certain enterprise pricing are handled off-marketplace. If Meditron prefers an AWS Marketplace purchase, we can route the pilot that way — it speeds procurement but has marketplace fee considerations.

Next steps we recommend to keep timelines tight:
1) Please confirm expected pilot payment method (card vs NET30 invoice). If card, confirm cardholder and spending threshold (we can put a cap).
2) If you expect to convert to production with a PO, please share your PO workflow and expected timeline so we can provision contractual steps (MSA + PO process).
3) I attached a vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf and redwood_msa_sample.docx — can your AP/legal review and call out any gating items?

I'll loop Karthik for any technical questions around dedicated capacity and Marissa for procurement playbook/support. Happy to hop on a 20-min call with your AP if that helps.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai | (503) 555-0124

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf (PDF, 230KB); redwood_msa_sample.docx (DOCX, 82KB)
From: Amy Cho <amy.cho@meditron.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@meditron.com>
Cc: ap@meditron.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on yesterday's demo — procurement questions

Vanessa / Jordan — copying AP so they have context. A couple of specific asks from AP before we can onboard Redwood as a vendor: 

1) Preferred payment terms (confirm NET30 availability for early pilot invoices)
2) Do you accept invoicing via Coupa or can you provide an invoice CSV we ingest?
3) Do you require a signed MSA before issuing a PO or can we create a vendor profile and issue a PO referencing standard T&Cs?
4) If we go card for the pilot, can you supply formal receipts/invoice lines for our cost-allocation reports?

Also — please confirm your vendor legal name, tax ID (we won't publish that publicly) and a primary AP contact so we can flag your vendor profile for expedited onboarding.

Thanks,
Amy Cho
Director, Procurement 
Meditron Therapeutics
amy.cho@meditron.com

Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up on yesterday's demo — procurement questions

Amy / Jordan / AP team — thanks for the clear list. Quick confirmation and next steps below.

1) Payment terms: For the pilot we can accept card and will provide full invoice/receipt lines for your cost allocation. For production (defined as > $10k/month or when you request Dedicated capacity) we typically require a signed MSA and a PO. NET30 is supported for production invoicing once the MSA is in place.

2) Coupa / invoicing: We do not have a direct Coupa integration today but can produce invoice exports compatible with Coupa (CSV or XML) and email invoices to ap@meditron.com or push them via SFTP. If you prefer AWS Marketplace procurement, we can route pilot billing there (note marketplace fees).

3) Contracting & vendor entry: We can accept a PO referencing our standard terms, but to unlock dedicated capacity and SLA credits we require a signed MSA. To accelerate onboarding I've attached the vendor packet and a clickable DocuSign link for our standard MSA: https://app.docusign.com/requests/ABCD-2027-MSA-RDW. If you'd like redlines, share them and we'll triage.

4) Tax & compliance: Redwood legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc. — we will provide a W9 and tax ID to your AP team over secure channels. SOC2 link provided earlier; happy to get a point-in-time SPI or redacted evidence if needed.

Proposed short mutual action plan (MAP) to keep pilot in the next 2 weeks:
- Today: Meditron confirms pilot payment method (card vs NET30 invoice) and cardholder if applicable.
- Within 48 hrs: AP confirms whether they will create a Coupa vendor or accept manual packet.
- If PO path chosen: Meditron to issue a preliminary PO (or expected timeline) so we can loop legal and schedule provisioning.
- If card path chosen: Provide cardholder and spend cap; we’ll enable the project and share on/off ramps for scaling.

I'll assign Marissa as onboarding lead on our side; Karthik will be available for any technical capacity or dedicated-hosting questions. If helpful, I'm happy to set a 20-minute AP onboarding call tomorrow morning.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Enterprise AE
Redwood Inference
